name: Baylen Out Loud
description: Follow the journey of Baylen Dupree, a young woman living with Tourette Syndrome. Despite her daily challenges, Baylen, her family, and long-term boyfriend aren't afraid to laugh and embrace the chaos that makes their everyday lives unique.

videos.title: I Have Tourette's Stupid!
videos.overview: Baylen Dupree is a young adult living with Tourette Syndrome and it impacts every aspect of her life and the lives of her parents and five siblings. Ready to be an independent adult, Baylen tries to navigate a world full of triggers and danger, but a phone call from her boyfriend during her brother’s birthday might turn her whole world upside down.

videos.title: The Airport is a Tic Disaster
videos.overview: Baylen learns what Colin's work relocation could mean for their relationship. Baylen is invited to be a guest panelist at a Tourette's Convention in Dallas but airports and flying can be a recipe for disaster.

videos.title: We All Have Tourette's
videos.overview: Baylen travels to Texas for a Tourette convention, but her tics threaten to overpower her big moment. After connecting with new friends and a doctor who suggests a radical treatment, it all proves too much for Baylen when she suffers a severe tic attack.

videos.title: Going For Narnia!
videos.overview: After suffering a terrifying tic attack, questions are raised about Baylen's ability to live on her own. Baylen and Colin decide to take a big step in their relationship, but the excitement is short-lived as they begin sharing the news with their families.

videos.title: It Was Him, Chainsaws, Me
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin are excited to live together but they need an approval from Colin's very conservative parents first. Allen, still uneasy about their decision, talks man to man with Colin. Baylen tries Botox to help with her tics. Colin drops a life changing bomb.

videos.title: I Have News
videos.overview: After an eventful apartment hunting adventure, Baylen and Colin move in together, but outside forces bring everything to a halt. At Baylen's birthday party, tension is in the air as Colin's birthday surprise royally backfires, leaving Baylen wondering if they're on the same page.

videos.title: What If My Dad Says No?
videos.overview: After a huge fight at Baylen's birthday party, Colin works on rebuilding trust with her family. Allen and Julie worry Baylen's tics are getting worse and wonder if Deep Brain Stimulation could be an option. Colin breaks the news to Julie and Allen about his true intentions with Baylen.

videos.title: You Don't Have To Stare Into My Soul
videos.overview: Colin seeks Baylen's parents' blessing to propose to her during their family vacation. Baylen and her parents meet with a neurologist to discuss Deep Brain Stimulation. Colin realizes its going to be an uphill battle after a secret meeting with Allen.

videos.title: This Is a Big Plot Twist
videos.overview: The Duprees head to the beach for their annual family vacation where Colin secretly plans to propose, but a brewing thunderstorm threatens to ruin his proposal plans. Sammi takes the opportunity to share some long-harbored concerns with Baylen. Baylen and Colin drop one last bombshell on the entire family.

videos.title: Obsessed with Everything
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin are enjoying being fiancés but are dragging their feet on wedding planning. Baylen questions Allen about an unresolved issue. A reluctant Baylen makes a cake for Colin's birthday. Her parents spring a surprising request on them.

videos.title: The Ticcer
videos.overview: Baylen has an unexpected reaction to the first wedding venue she and Colin tour. Baylen meets with her CBIT therapist to discuss goals for her wedding day. At their first pre-marital counseling session, Colin reveals he's been keeping a secret.

videos.title: Addicted All Around
videos.overview: Colin's surprising admission to Baylen throws a wrench in the wedding vision. Sammi and Burke don't hold back in sharing their opinions with Baylen while Allen concocts a master plan that he hopes Baylen will be on board with for her big day.

videos.title: Anxiety On High Alert
videos.overview: Baylen hosts a sleepover for her brother, Bechnir, while Allen and Julie seize the rare chance to have a date night. Bechnir confides in Baylen about his severe anxiety and a major wedding venue debate forces Allen to confront the painful history behind his fierce protectiveness.

videos.title: It's So Inappropriate!
videos.overview: Baylen's new tic about Colin's mom has her dreading their trip to Roanoke. Colin turns to his sister for advice on his career after the military. Julie and Allen have a bigger discussion about Bechnir's anxiety. Colin invites some surprising guests to a venue tour, leaving Baylen feeling ambushed.

videos.title: She's Gonna Lose Her Mind
videos.overview: During counseling, the therapist throws a wrench in Colin's plan to confront Allen. Baylen and Colin fall in love with a wedding venue, but when they see the Dupree backyard transformed for the engagement party, they second guess everything. A surprise from Allen brings Baylen to tears.

videos.title: Did I Mention That I Have Tourette?
videos.overview: At their engagement party, Baylen and Colin finally announce they've chosen the wedding venue of their dreams but it's a decision that leaves both Julie and Allen struggling to find their place in Baylen's wedding plans. Colin decides it’s now-or-never to set boundaries with Allen, and the four come together for a dinner where tensions reach a breaking point.

videos.title: Saddle Up
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin's plan to set boundaries turns upside down when Allen pressures Colin to have a back-up plan for his new real estate career. Baylen confronts her fear of horses through intense ERP therapy. And the couples gets a harsh reality check at their first meeting with their wedding planner.

videos.title: I'm on the Struggle Bus
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin find themselves in an impossible situation with the wedding. Julie learns about a new device that could help Baylen with her tics. Baylen readies herself for wedding dress shopping, but it's bittersweet without Sammi. On their drive to meet Dr. Flaherty, Colin drops a truth bomb on Baylen.

videos.title: Get Me Out of Here!
videos.overview: Baylen grows curious about a groundbreaking new device for her tics but would need to leave the country to try it. A trip to the library is anything but uneventful for Baylen. Colin takes the first step in his new career and learns just how hard it can be to succeed...

videos.title: Your Anxiety Is Giving Me Anxiety
videos.overview: While meeting with their wedding planners, Baylen and Colin are dealt another blow to their wedding budget. The Duprees are off to London for a potential life-changing experience as Baylen will get to try a device that could reduce her tics. However, Baylen's difficulty navigating the airport and Colin's severe flight anxiety threatens to derail the journey before it begins.

videos.title: Ticcing in a British Accent
videos.overview: The Dupree's arrive in London! And they must quickly navigate the culture shock. On a double-decker tour bus, Baylen becomes overstimulated, and her tics escalate, causing her a lot of distress. The Dupree's are excited to try English cuisine but when Baylen becomes the focus in a small pub, they worry how much more she can handle.

videos.title: My Brain Feels Different
videos.overview: After dealing with escalating tics throughout London, Baylen finally gets to try a device that could help reduce her tics and possibly change her life forever. Baylen and Colin reconsider their future plans, leaving Allen and Julie stunned...

videos.title: It's Time To Party
videos.overview: With less than seven months to their big day, Baylen and Colin are still struggling to make major wedding decisions; Baylen and maid of honor Sammi are at odds over the planning of Baylen and Colin's joint bachelor and bachelorette weekend.

videos.title: Altared Plans
videos.overview: When Sammi fails to show up to their joint Bach weekend, Baylen has an honest conversation with Sammi about her role; after Julie raises concerns about how remote the venue is, Baylen proposes a plan that might put the entire wedding day in jeopardy.

videos.title: Unsave the Date
videos.overview: Baylen's holiday tics are in full swing as Baylen and Colin embrace the holiday spirit by taking Christmas photos with Santa and the dogs. Allen plans a heartfelt surprise for his and Julie's 25th anniversary. Baylen and Colin reveal a major wedding decision that could dramatically change their timeline.

videos.title: Say Yes to the Stress
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin's wedding announcement sends everyone into planning overdrive. With even less time to wedding plan, and with the help of her mom and grandmothers, Baylen heads to Florida to find her perfect wedding dress. Allen receives major news that could uproot the entire family.

videos.title: Knot on My Bingo Card
videos.overview: Baylen's search for her dream wedding dress yields too many contenders. Anxiety goes into overdrive as Baylen and Julie head to Kansas for a girls' weekend with Sammi. And Sammi's surprise outing pushes Baylen outside her comfort zone.

videos.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Sammi's planned surprises lead to Baylen and Julie making some permanent decisions and spending an evening at a funeral home. Baylen reveals a worrisome medical concern. Then, strong opinions during wedding planning put the sisters at odds again.

videos.title: Roses Are Red, Officiants Are Bald
videos.overview: Baylen returns from her Kansas City girls' trip still hurt by Sammi's Bridezilla comment and unsure where they stand. Hoping to lift her spirits, Colin plans a Valentine's Day surprise while the couple meets a potential wedding officiant. Just when Baylen starts to relax, Colin reveals a surprise she never saw coming. Bechnir begrudgingly tux shops.

videos.title: A Tasting of Things to Come
videos.overview: After surprising Baylen with a wedding day change, the couple goes to their menu tasting where Colin drops another bombshell that could impact their future together. Meanwhile, Julie worries the mounting pressure on Sammi to pull off the perfect celebration could further strain her already fragile relationship with Baylen.

videos.title: Showered With Opinions
videos.overview: Baylen's bridal shower finally arrives, but the celebration takes a turn.

videos.title: To Have and To Hold...A Mortgage
videos.overview: Baylen and Colin travel to Myrtle Beach to explore a possible relocation.

videos.title: Dance Now or Forever Hold Your Peace
